module_summary: Static address decoder wrapper: forwards address and rule map to a cc_addr_decode_dync instance with configuration tied off, returning matched index, valid and error.

anchors.name: addr_i
anchors.why: Address to decode, passed to child decoder.

anchors.name: addr_map_i
anchors.why: Rule table of index and address ranges.

anchors.name: idx_o
anchors.why: Decoded rule index from child decoder.

anchors.name: dec_valid_o
anchors.why: Indicates a rule matched the address.

anchors.name: dec_error_o
anchors.why: Indicates no rule matched the address.

anchors.name: en_default_idx_i
anchors.why: Enables default index on no match.

anchors.name: default_idx_i
anchors.why: Default index returned when enabled and no match.

groups.name: Address decoder
groups.description: cc_addr_decode_dync instance matching address against rules.
